description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface, wrapping Android's native Log utility to enable flexible logging chaining in an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility, forwarding log messages to the next LogNode in a chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable; forwards the log to the next node if present.
